summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a Board resolution to pay a year-end dividend of ¥51.00 per share (record date March 31, 2026), subject to shareholder approval at the June 26, 2026 ordinary general meeting. The annual dividend totals ¥86.00 per share, an increase from ¥64.00 in the prior fiscal year. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing is a standard report of surplus distribution, reflecting the company's capital management policy and profit growth.
